title: Fare Bands for Checked-Bag Charges — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Pricing schedule — checked bags on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The list charge of a checked bag is multiplied by the **fare band rate**, which follows the fare that bands the bag charge. The rate acts on the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

| Fare that bands the bag charge (USD) | Fare band rate |
|---|---|
| 500 or more (high fare floor) | 0.9 |
| At least 300 (middle fare floor) and below 500 | 0.95 |
| Below 300 | 1 |

The fare that bands the bag charge is measured from the ticket's fares; the fare collected on the ticket is every fare-collection and add-collect entry on its fare history.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Fare that bands the charge | Rate |
|---|---|
| 500.00 | 0.9 |
| 499.99 | 0.95 |
| 300.00 | 0.95 |
| 299.99 | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A list charge of 80 dollars in the 0.95 band becomes 76.00 dollars.
